# Retry policy decision

## Decision needed

Choose whether retry cadence is fixed or configurable.

## Options

- Fixed cadence: lower configuration risk.
- Configurable cadence: more operator control.

## Recommendation

Use a fixed cadence until runtime evidence justifies configuration.
